newsitem.title: CHINA: Hainan Airlines to launch 71 mln B share IPO.
newsitem.headline: Hainan Airlines to launch 71 mln B share IPO.

text.p: Hainan Airlines Co Ltd will make an initial public offering of 71 million foreign currency B shares on Monday and Tuesday at a price of 3.90 yuan, equivalent to $0.47 per share, a company prospectus said on Monday.

The proceeds from the share issue, for listing on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, will be used to buy three Boeing 767 planes over the next two years, the prospectus in Monday's China Securities newspaper said.
After the issue, the company will have a total of 471.16 million shares outstanding, of which B shares account for 15 percent, it said.

The remaining shares include 240.12 million or 51 percent shares held by domestic institutions, 100.04 million or 21.3 percent held by AMR American Airlines Co Ltd and 60 million shares owned by company staff, it said.
J&A Securities Co Ltd is the main underwriter, it added.

The company is also planning to issue 17.53 million A shares before the end of 1997 for listing on the Shanghai bourse, which has been approved by the Hainan securities administration office, the prospectus said.

The company reaped 89.076 million yuan net profit in 1996 based on international accounting standards, a massive increase from 38.589 million yuan in 1995, it said, adding that the company forecast its 1997 net profit to be no less than 140 million yuan.
